summary: A major correctness release: generic vectors and reflect no longer corrupt the heap, the silent TcpStream.read elision is gone, confined unsafe loops no longer exhaust the stack, and installed toolchains resolve all runtime sources.

highlights.title: Angle-bracket generic receivers keep their type arguments
highlights.text: Vec receivers written with angle brackets silently lost their type argument, so Vec of TypeInfo new allocated 8-byte slots while pushing 128-byte elements and reflect.all_types() corrupted the heap with 0xC0000374. The parser now keeps the type arguments, and Map pair spellings are covered too.

highlights.title: A one-argument method named read is no longer swallowed
highlights.text: A raw-pointer codegen builtin hijacked any one-argument read method, so a socket read into a mutable buffer never ran its body and Result.is_ok folded to false. Verified against a live server on AOT and JIT builds; this closes the R-8 TcpStream.read elision.

highlights.title: Confined unsafe loops no longer exhaust the stack
highlights.text: A confined unsafe block re-entered from a loop allocated its capture context per execution, consuming 32 bytes of stack each time; about 262,144 entries crashed with 0xC0000005. The context is now hoisted to the function entry and reused.

highlights.title: Installed toolchains find every runtime source
highlights.text: The AOT link step only scanned working-directory paths, so installed layouts missed their lib/runtime and any program using the monotonic clock failed with an undefined xiom_async_now_ms symbol. The shared stdlib resolver now supplies the candidate roots.

highlights.title: Exact Float64 bits and duplicate-free externs
highlights.text: num.float.float_bits and bits_to_float now lower to an LLVM bitcast, returning the exact IEEE-754 patterns, and a user extern of a builtin runtime symbol (for example xiom_guard_alloc) no longer emits a duplicate declaration that clang rejects.

known_issues: multipart_parse still returns corrupt Part field reads (name/filename/content_type/data); the root cause is isolated in codegen and the fix is queued for the next patch.
The geometry Box type cannot be named from consumer modules until the stdlib rename lands; a compiler-side resolution is possible as a fallback.
